verdict.rationale: Kimi is a consumer AI assistant, so connecting cloud drive, email, and calendar data is a fair question for this kind of product. The pack has no documented connector for any of them. The nearest items are adjacent: manual file upload Q&A, a generic plugins-and-skills help heading, and a 'Kimi Claw' help heading about connecting to Feishu. None of these shows the assistant searching a user's drive, mailbox, or calendar to answer questions.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers
